help.title: Test commands
help.text:
/t me — who I am, this chat, the open chat
/t send — a normal, a silent and a scheduled message
/t ask — “Yes/No” and text boxes (tg.async)
/t ask2 — a box with a callback instead of tg.async
/t copy — text to the clipboard
/t timer — a timer in 3 s and a 3-2-1 countdown
/t files — files and settings of the plugin
/t json — tg.json there and back
/t lang — plugin.t and tg.lang()
/t invoke — raw MTProto requests and errors
/t secure — a sensitive request: the client must ask first
/t get — the last incoming message in this chat
/t compose — the plugin puts text into the message field
/t refresh — apply the [fg] replacement again
/t error, /t loop, /t mem — protection: an error, an endless loop, 64 MB

Also: write “[fg] hello” and the chat shows [fg] as ✅.
The link https://example.com/fgtest does not open: the plugin takes it.
The 👎 reaction is cancelled by the plugin, the others show a notice.
“Test: …” items are in the menus of a message, a chat (⋮), a profile and in the main menu. More checks are on the settings page.
